name: What is the tradeoff between steel and wood garage doors?

mainEntity.name: What is the tradeoff between steel and wood garage doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Steel doors offer exceptional durability, low maintenance, and cost-effectiveness, making them the most popular choice for everyday family homes. Real wood doors deliver unmatched natural beauty and custom curb appeal, but they require ongoing maintenance, periodic staining, and protection from moisture. A wood door adds weight, which demands heavier spring systems and regular upkeep. Steel requires very little attention once installed. When choosing, consider whether you want classic architectural warmth or a durable, weather-resistant finish with minimal upkeep.
acceptedAnswer.description: Steel offers high durability, lower cost, and minimal maintenance. Wood delivers rich architectural beauty but requires regular sealing, weighs more, and costs more to purchase and maintain.
